To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) SART3•snRNP complexes are present in Cajal bodies, 2) SART3 complexes containing U6 snRNA and U4/U6 di-snRNA are localized in the nucleoplsm and Cajal bodies, respectively, and 3) U6 snRNA is present in the nucleoplism in the absence of U4/U6 assembly.
the SART3•snRNP complexes are localized to different nuclear compartments and that the SART•snRNP assembly occurs in the CBs.
SART3 is required for U4-U6 snRNP formation, SART3 is present in Cajal bodies and SART3 is a component of the U4/U6 small nuclear ribonuleoprotein particle.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the assembly of spliceosomal snRNPs, which are required for pre- mRNA splicing. snRNPs are composed of small nuclear RNA molecules (U1, U2, U4, U5, and U6) that assemble with specific proteins. snRNP assembly is thought to be a multi-step process involving the sequential addition of proteins and snRNAs, and is believed to occur in the nucleoli and Cajal bodies ( CBs). snRNPs are also thought to assemble
the assembly of spliceosomal snRNPs and the role of Cajal bodies in this process.
the role of Cajal bodies (also known as coiled bodies, CBs), in the assembly of spliceosomal small nuclear riboprotein particles, snRNPs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Cajal bodies (also known as coiled bodies) are the site of snRNP biogenesis, and that this process involves the sequential recruitment of U1, U2, U4/U6, and U5 snRNPs to the CBs.
CBs provide a specialized nuclear compartment in which U4/U6 small nuclear ribonuleoprotein particle assembly occurs.
the Cajal bodies are not involved in snRNP maturation.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
SART3 is involved in U4/U6 small nuclear ribonuclear protein (snRNP) biogenesis and that it is involved in U6 snRNP maturation and U4/U6 assembly.
CBs are required for the assembly and/or maturation of SART3-containing U4/U6 small nuclear ribonuclear protein particles.
SART3 is a key factor in the assembly and localization of snRNPs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Cajal bodies (a nuclear sub-compartment) are involved in the assembly of snRNP complexes.
CBs are not required for U4 snRNP assembly in vivo, but they are required for U4 and U6 snRNPs to assemble into U4/U6.U5 tri-snRNPs in vivo.
CBs are not simply a site for snRNP assembly.
